in_sanskrit.name: दिव्यानी
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: दिव्य (divy) means sacred, divine. नी (nī) means new, fresh, or radiant.

in_hindi.name: दिव्यानी
in_hindi.long_meaning: शुद्ध (shuddh) means pure, clean, or unadulterated. दिव्य (divy) means sacred, divine. नी (nī) means new, fresh, or radiant.

in_tamil.name: திவ்யானி
in_tamil.meaning: அதிகாரிக்கு வாழ்த்துக்கள் அல்லவுக்கு அறிவிப்பு அல்லது பிரகாசம்
in_tamil.long_meaning: திவ் (thiv) means god, divine. யானி (yāni) means one who is devoted to god or one who has god's grace.

in_telugu.name: దివ్యానీ
in_telugu.long_meaning: శద్ద (shadda) means pure, clean, or unadulterated. దివ్య (divy) means sacred, divine. నీ (nī) means new, fresh, or radiant.

in_marathi.name: Divyani
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Divine, Celestial, Radiant
in_marathi.long_meaning: Divyani हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Divyani is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Divy’, meaning divine, and ‘Ani’, meaning one or unique. This name is bestowed upon a child believed to be a divine and unique presence in the world.
